caption: The drawing depicts a quilt pattern composed of six rectangular panels arranged in two columns and three rows. Each panel features a symmetrical floral motif with a central red flower that has a circular yellow center surrounded by multiple layers of red petals. Radiating from each central flower are four large green leaves arranged crosswise, and curving green stems with smaller green leaves extend outward in a circular pattern, often ending in red buds outlined in green. Additional small red flowers with yellow centers are distributed around the central motif within each panel. The background of each panel consists of a white surface with a crosshatched pattern. The outer and inner edges of each panel are bordered with a solid red line, and the panels are separated by thinner red divider lines. The colors predominantly used are various shades of green, red, and yellow, with the background in white. The overall composition is geometric and symmetrical, with the repeated design creating a grid across the entire drawing.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
